description: Local WEB-14a merge of accepted WEB-10a b9fd602f. IDs on accepted main remain unchanged. The 24 colliding WEB-14a entries move by +1000; their patches and expected tests are unchanged. Historical evidence and approval plans retain their original IDs and candidate identity; apply this explicit mapping to future WEB-14a selections, never reinterpret old results as covering main entries. The accepted WEB-08d merge of 27 October 2026 also moves seven colliding WEB-14a UNIT IDs 1701–1707 to 3701–3707; accepted-main IDs and historical evidence stay unchanged. WEB-14a/WEB-11a integration 2 November 2026: no additional within-layer ID collisions; both parent entries retained, old evidence keeps original identity.
